_about: Package VG: the Twin Dial placed on the G20 panel (1920 x 720, continuous px, y down). R = the bezel ring's centre line (VR / VD). Dials from tools/twin-dial/vg/fit_layout.py on design/twin-dial/vg/dial_units.json (rev 2, VD dials.json v1); frame from VF's published frame_spec.json and message_panel.json. docs/twin-dial/VG-REPORT.md explains every entry.

dials.status: verified as a fit (every clearance below computed); the dial units it rests on are VD's (verified on 02) except the furniture box (hypothesis)

clearances_px.rule: >= 3 from every BMW item (strip round); the ring's foot is the disc's lowest point

telltales_holes.what: see-through holes in our background (relation unknown, plan.safe), nothing of ours inside

gear_gap.what: NO layer rectangle of ours intersects it (bg split in three)

cc_fallback_window.outline: zc.panel dilated by 3 px (VF message_panel.json fallback_window.polygon_px)

dial_furniture_rule: nothing of a dial below y 657 where x is in 494..691 or 1377..1463

frame._source: VF frame_spec.json (published 2026-11-17, lead ref 02), u from the midpoint between the dials, v from the centre line, both in R; x = 960 + 300 u, y = 400 + 300 v

telltale_strip.use: stays black: BMW's own lamps on the G20 are at the sides; nothing of ours is a lamp

bottom_row.note: inside BMW's message panel footprint: by design, our message (VF M2 plate [694.5,592,1230,720]) replaces it
